team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1 Crown of the Final Scion: after the equipping character creates a Shield, the active party member's DMG is increased by 10% per 1,000 ATK the wielder has, up to 26% ('on field'); a Hexerei character who is off-field instead gets 50% of that increase ('hexerei off field', 13%). This is a universal DMG bonus — it applies to every hit of the rotation whatever its element, including Physical. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).
